summaryZh: 心智与发展实验室研究儿童如何理解他人，以及工具、艺术、音乐和技术等人造事物的社会意义。团队也研究音乐性的起源及其早期社会影响；方法未明确。
researchQuestions: 人的音乐性为何在生命早期就发展，并从早期就产生社会影响？

evidence.quote: Welcome to the Mind and Development Lab at UC San Diego! We study the cognitive processes that allow children to understand other people, and the social meaning of things people create, such as tools, art, music, and technology. We also explore the origins of musicality, asking why human musicality is so early developing and socially impactful from early in life. Our work has been funded by the NSF, NIH, APF, and GRAMMY Foundation.
